title.zh: 首达

dek.en: PhD research: when a random walker first arrives
dek.zh: 博士研究：随机游走何时第一次到达

card.en: Why one target can have two arrival peaks — and exactly when the second one dies. A single-author paper, submitted to Physical Review E.
card.zh: 一个目标为何会有两个到达峰，第二个峰又何时消失——单作者论文，已投稿《物理评论 E》。

why.en: First-passage times are everywhere a search has to succeed: a molecule finding a receptor, a signal crossing a network, a pest finding a trap (Chapter 07).
why.zh: 凡是需要「找到」的地方都有首达时间：分子找到受体、信号穿过网络、害虫走进诱捕器（见第 07 章）。

thesis.en: Why can a single target produce two arrival peaks? A year on rings, lattices and catalyst stripes that became a single-author paper submitted to Physical Review E (a physics journal), 46 theorems checked in Lean (a proof assistant, where a computer checks every step) and a public archive anyone can re-run.
thesis.zh: 一个目标，为什么会有两个到达峰？在环、格点与催化条带之间走了一年，走出一篇投给《物理评论 E》（Physical Review E）的单作者论文、46 条用 Lean（一种让计算机逐行检查数学证明的软件）核验的定理，和一个谁都能复跑的公开仓库。

status.en: Submitted to Physical Review E · Jul 2026

card.en: Single-author regular article, the capstone of the double-peak line. Submitted to Physical Review E (a physics journal), 30 Jul 2026.
card.zh: 单作者常规论文，双峰研究线的收官之作。2026 年 7 月 30 日投稿《物理评论 E》（Physical Review E），审稿中。

title.en: Why a second peak is born — and dies
title.zh: 第二个峰为何出生，又为何消失

card.en: A shortcut acts as a rank-one killing defect; the late peak vanishes in a saddle-node fold at a threshold b_c ≈ 3.08.
card.zh: 捷径就是一个秩一吸收缺陷；晚峰在阈值 b_c ≈ 3.08 处，经鞍结折叠消失。

title.zh: 跳过输入法？

dek.en: First AI paper · UKAIRS 2026, the UK AI Research Symposium
dek.zh: 第一篇 AI 论文 · 英国 AI 研究研讨会（UKAIRS 2026）

card.en: An IME turns typed letters into Chinese characters. Can you skip it and send an AI agent pinyin (romanised Chinese)? Yes — except for homophones.
card.zh: 直接用拼音跟 AI 智能体说话行不行？日常指令可以，同音词要留一个汉字。第一篇 AI 论文，UKAIRS 2026 录用。

why.en: Many languages are typed through an input method — software that turns typed letters into characters — or a romanisation: pinyin (romanised Chinese), Japanese romaji, Arabizi. Knowing where meaning survives the shortcut tells people when they can skip that step with an AI agent.
why.zh: 很多语言都要靠输入法或罗马化来打字——拼音、日语罗马字、阿拉伯语的拉丁转写。弄清楚意思在哪里会丢，才知道什么时候可以跟 AI 智能体省掉这一步。

thesis.en: Can Chinese speakers skip the input method — the software that turns typed letters into characters — and type raw pinyin (romanised Chinese) straight to an AI agent? In a small pilot of 48 real calls: for the routine tasks tested, yes — but homophones collapse, and one word kept in Chinese characters brings the meaning back. The first AI paper, accepted at UKAIRS 2026 in Edinburgh.
thesis.zh: 和 AI 智能体说话，能不能跳过输入法、直接敲拼音？一项 48 次真实调用的小规模测试给出的答案是：所测的日常指令可以；可一遇同音词，意思就塌了——只要把关键词留成汉字，意思便回来了。这是第一篇 AI 论文，入选在爱丁堡举行的英国 AI 研究研讨会（UKAIRS 2026）。

title.en: The key finding: toneless pinyin erases homophones
title.zh: 核心发现：无声调拼音抹掉同音字

card.en: 事实 and 实施 are both ‘shi shi’. Pinyin-only prompts scored 0.333; keeping the key word in Chinese characters restored 1.00.
card.zh: 「事实」与「实施」都是 shi shi。纯拼音提示只得 0.333；把关键词留成汉字，就回到 1.00。

title.en: Accepted at UKAIRS 2026: the first AI paper

card.en: UKAIRS 2026 accepted the paper for a poster. The reviewers singled out the ‘shi shi’ example as the message to lead with.
card.zh: UKAIRS 2026 录用本文，以海报展示。评审特别点出「shi shi」这个例子，建议以它开场。

card.en: Models propose, other agents attack, numerics arbitrate, Lean checks the algebra. Belief is earned, not generated.
card.zh: 模型提出，另一组智能体攻击，数值来裁决，Lean 核验代数。信念要靠挣，不靠生成。

title.zh: 引擎室

dek.en: R&D Scientist (AI) at Yuexin International, a cloud-communications company
dek.zh: 阅信国际 · AI 研发

card.en: Since June 2026 at Yuexin International: six AI systems built and live in four months — a gateway, a governed platform, a staff assistant.
card.zh: 2026 年 6 月起在阅信国际做 AI 研发：四个月里搭建并上线六套 AI 系统——网关、治理平台、员工助手等。

why.en: The aim: move a company from trying AI to using it every day — safely, with governance built in, and with people holding every gate that has consequences.
why.zh: 目标是让一家公司从「试试 AI」走到每天都在用 AI——安全、内置治理，凡是有后果的关口都由人来把守。

thesis.en: Since June 2026, alongside the PhD: built the internal AI gateway, an enterprise platform for governed model access, a staff AI assistant, and the connectors that let agents work inside the company's own tools.
thesis.zh: 2026 年 6 月起，与读博并行：搭建了内部 AI 网关、受治理的企业模型接入平台、员工 AI 助手，以及让智能体在公司自有工具里干活的连接器。

title.en: R&D Scientist (AI) at Yuexin International, a cloud-communications company
title.zh: 阅信国际 · AI 研发

card.en: From June 2026, alongside the PhD: the company's AI platform and model gateway, AI tools for colleagues, and AI for global messaging.
card.zh: 2026 年 6 月起，与读博并行：为公司搭建 AI 平台与模型网关、给同事用的 AI 工具，以及面向国际短信业务的 AI 支持。

title.zh: 阅信 AI 助手——网页版与 Windows 版

card.en: Built and launched in a day: a staff assistant with single sign-on, personal quotas, self-serve keys and a Windows client.
card.zh: 一天内做出并上线的员工助手：飞书登录、个人额度、自助领取密钥，外加 Windows 客户端。

title.en: An enterprise platform for governed AI access
title.zh: 企业 AI 统一接入与治理平台

card.en: Organisations, teams, keys, model allow-lists, budgets, a data-loss hook and an audit hash-chain — built and live in one week.
card.zh: 组织、团队、密钥、模型白名单、预算、防泄漏回调与审计哈希链——一周之内搭好并上线。

title.zh: 展台

dek.en: Brand design, trade shows and talks

card.en: Giving a cloud-communications company an AI-era face: a logo system, materials for two trade shows (MWC Shanghai, WWC Madrid), a 93-minute AI primer.
card.zh: 为一家云通信公司打造 AI 时代的形象：一套标志、上海与马德里两场展会的物料、一堂 93 分钟的大模型入门课。

why.en: A company that sold messaging had to learn to show itself as an AI company — in English, on trade floors and in print — and its own staff had to learn to work with AI agents.
why.zh: 一家做短信的公司，要学会用英文、在展会上、在印刷品里，把自己展示成一家 AI 公司；公司自己的员工，也要学会和 AI 智能体一起工作。

thesis.en: How a messaging company learns to present itself as an AI company: a first overseas brand push, a logo argued from four sketches into one mark, materials for two trade shows, and a 93-minute primer that explained the large-language-model (LLM) industry through SMS.
thesis.zh: 一家短信公司如何把自己讲成一家 AI 公司：第一次海外品牌行动，一套从四张草图论证出来的标志，两场展会的物料，以及一堂用短信讲清大模型行业的 93 分钟入门课。

title.en: ‘Trust Joint 2.0’: a logo system argued into existence
title.zh: 「信榫 2.0」：一套被论证出来的标志

card.en: Four AI-sketched directions, audited for silhouette and similarity, rebuilt by hand on a 1000-unit grid: 20 master files, a 14-page guide.
card.zh: 四个 AI 草图方向，经剪影与相似度审查，在 1000 单位网格上手工重建：20 个母版文件，14 页规范。

title.en: ‘Intelligence. Delivered.’ — print and digital kit for a Madrid trade show
title.zh: 「智能，送达」——马德里展会的印刷与数字物料

card.en: Three rounds in four days: five one-pager types, three two-sided leaflets in two languages, four business cards — every QR code tested.
card.zh: 四天三轮：五种一页纸、中英文各三张双面宣传页、四张名片，二维码逐一解码验证。

title.en: ‘From SMS to Intelligent Channels’: a 93-minute primer on AI models
title.zh: 《从短信到智能通道》：93 分钟大模型入门课

card.en: A Chinese SMS is billed per 70 characters, a model per token: how the LLM industry works, told through a business the team already knew.
card.zh: 一条中文短信按 70 个字计费，大模型按词元（token）计费：用团队最熟悉的生意，讲清大模型行业的来龙去脉。

card.en: Three days with the company’s four-person team: a live schedule of 22 meeting slots, and 31 exhibitor dossiers written during the show.

title.zh: 教学

dek.zh: 研究生助教与实验课助教

card.en: A Graduate Teacher from the first month of the PhD — now 13 roles across three schools: tutorials, labs, problem classes, marking.
card.zh: 读博第一个月就当上研究生助教，如今在三个学院担任 13 个教学岗位：小班辅导、实验课、习题课与批改。

why.en: It puts the maths in front of students — first-year tutorials, MSc labs, group projects — and runs on the same AI-native, check-everything habits as the research.
why.zh: 它让数学真正落到学生面前——一年级小班课、硕士上机实验、小组项目——背后是和做研究一样的 AI 原生、凡事核验的习惯。

thesis.en: A Graduate Teacher from the first month of the PhD: problem classes, labs, marking and tutorials — now 13 teaching roles in three schools, run with the same AI-native habits as the research.
thesis.zh: 读博第一个月就当上研究生助教（Graduate Teacher）：习题课、实验课、批改与小班辅导。如今在三个学院担任 13 个教学岗位，用的是和做研究一样的 AI 原生工作方式。

thesis.en: Speaking for other PhD students, and for the university: a year as Engineering Mathematics PGR (postgraduate research) rep, and now a second; a scholarship reading panel, open days, a science festival — and seven minutes of stand-up about doing a maths PhD.
thesis.zh: 替博士生发声，也替学校待客：当了一年工程数学博士生代表，如今连任第二年；做奖学金评审、开放日学生大使、科学节志愿者——还在台上讲了七分钟关于读数学博士的单口喜剧。

title.zh: 按图布点

dek.zh: BioPath · 早期职业创业学者

card.en: First-passage maths as a product: BioPath tells farms where to put pest traps, with the proof attached. Early Career Enterprise Fellow, 2026.
card.zh: 把首达数学做成产品：BioPath 告诉农场诱捕器该放哪儿，并附上证明。2026 年早期职业创业学者。

why.en: Where a trap goes decides how soon a pest is caught — and better placement can cut the reliance on chemical rodenticides.
why.zh: 诱捕器放在哪里，决定了害虫多快被抓住；布点更准，就能减少对化学灭鼠剂的依赖。

thesis.en: First-passage maths turned into a product: BioPath takes a site map and a budget and returns where to put the traps — with the proof attached. One of twelve Early Career Enterprise Fellows in the 2026 cohort, a pitch award from New Enterprise (Bristol’s start-up programme) and a PechaKucha (20 slides × 20 seconds) at the Festival of Enterprise.
thesis.zh: 把首达数学做成产品：BioPath 输入场地地图与预算，输出诱捕器该放在哪儿——并附上证明。由此成为 2026 届早期职业创业学者（全届 12 人），拿到布里斯托大学创业孵化项目 New Enterprise 的路演奖，并在创业节上做了一场 PechaKucha（20 页幻灯片、每页 20 秒的快闪演讲）。

card.zh: BioPath——面向精准虫害管理的仿生优化工具——入选 2026 届，全届共 12 位学者。

title.zh: BioPath 平台：地图进，布点出，附证明

card.en: A site map and a budget in; trap coordinates that optimise first-passage capture out — with a proof bundle anyone can re-run.
card.zh: 输入场地地图与预算，输出使首达捕获最优的诱捕器坐标——外加一份谁都能复跑的证明包。

title.zh: 信号

card.en: What was published, and the studio behind it: LinkedIn as a notebook, a WeChat studio since August 2026, bilingual subtitles, this site.
card.zh: 发出去的作品，和背后的工作室：领英当笔记本，2026 年 8 月起的微信内容工作室，双语字幕，以及这个网站。

why.en: The record is also how the work reaches people: posts, talks and videos in two languages — with every number here an aggregate and every private clip kept private.
why.zh: 记录本身也是作品抵达别人的方式：中英两种语言的帖子、演讲与视频；这里的数字一律是汇总，私人片段一律不公开。

thesis.en: A camera roll kept since 2023, a WeChat studio launched in August 2026 (the enterprise pitch and an interview are on WeChat Channels), LinkedIn as a public notebook, a home-built bilingual subtitle pipeline — and the making of this site.
thesis.zh: 2023 年起从未停下的手机影像，2026 年 8 月启动的微信内容工作室（创业路演与一次专访已发在视频号），被当作公开笔记本的领英，自己搭的中英双语字幕流水线——以及这个网站是怎样做出来的。

title.zh: 微信内容工作室

card.en: Launched August 2026: an agent-run studio turning years of phone footage into short videos for WeChat — a human always presses publish.
card.zh: 2026 年 8 月启动：由智能体运转的工作室，把多年的手机影像做成微信短视频——「发表」键永远由人来按。

title.en: A camera roll as a diary: 3,947 videos
title.zh: 把相机胶卷当日记：3,947 段视频

card.en: September 2023 to August 2026: 140, 1,310, 1,574 and 923 videos a year. Aggregates only — no clip is ever shown.

title.zh: 本站：首达 · 第 1 期

card.en: A live first-passage experiment on one life — at the address that spent 2026 redirecting to LinkedIn.
card.zh: 一场在一段人生上运行的首达实验——就在这个 2026 年一直跳转到领英的网址上。

title.zh: 向西

dek.en: Silicon Valley, 2025 · an internship at LiveX AI, a Bay Area AI start-up
dek.zh: 2025 年夏 · 硅谷 AI 创业公司 LiveX AI 实习

card.en: Summer 2025 in Silicon Valley: an entrepreneurship programme and a research internship at LiveX AI — where the turn toward AI began.
card.zh: 2025 年夏在硅谷：一段创业研学，外加 LiveX AI 的研究实习——转向 AI 从这里开始。

why.en: It is where the question behind the later AI work first appeared: judge a tool by whether its output answers real questions, not by how it looks.
why.zh: 后来 AI 工作背后的那个问题，最早出现在这里：评判一个工具，要看它的输出能不能回答真实问题，而不是看它长得好不好。

thesis.en: Summer 2025: a university programme in Silicon Valley and a two-week research internship at LiveX AI, where the question was how to turn messy manuals into Markdown an AI can actually use. The turning point toward AI — and a walker that is still walking.
thesis.zh: 2025 年夏：硅谷的一段大学研学项目，外加在 LiveX AI 的两周研究实习——课题是怎样把杂乱的产品手册变成 AI 真正用得上的 Markdown。这是转向 AI 的转折点，也是一个至今仍在游走的粒子。

title.en: A research internship at LiveX AI, a Bay Area start-up
title.zh: 在硅谷 AI 创业公司 LiveX AI 的研究实习

card.en: 4–16 August 2025, Silicon Valley: finding the most reliable way to turn product manuals into clean Markdown for an AI knowledge base.
card.zh: 2025 年 8 月 4 日至 16 日，硅谷：为 AI 知识库寻找把产品手册转成干净 Markdown 的最可靠方法。

title.zh: 硅谷创业项目

card.en: About three weeks on Tianjin University's programme in the Bay Area, run with Founders Space: workshops, company visits, founders.
card.zh: 在天津大学与 Founders Space 合办的湾区项目里待了约三周：工作坊、企业参访、与创业者交流。

title.en: An open retrieval-QA benchmark for document parsers
title.zh: 一个开源的文档解析检索问答基准

card.en: Parsers judged by usefulness, not looks: 5 parsers × 9 documents × 100 questions, with overconfidence tracked.
card.zh: 不看长得像不像，只看有没有用：5 个解析器 × 9 份文档 × 100 道题，并统计过度自信。

title.zh: 作坊

card.en: Built in the gaps, mostly so someone else could move faster: a maths guide, a travel-story app, a cursor tool, agent bridges.
card.zh: 见缝插针造出来的东西，多半是为了让别人走得更快：数学指北、旅行故事应用、光标工具、智能体之桥。

why.en: Small public tools are where new methods get tried first, and some outlive their moment: the Tianjin maths guide from 2023 is still in use.
why.zh: 小而公开的工具，是新方法最先试手的地方；有些还活得很久：2023 年的天大数学指北，至今仍有人在用。

thesis.en: Things built in the gaps: a maths guide for the next cohort, a travel-story studio born at a hackathon, a cursor that jumps between screens, bridges that let AI agents hand work to each other — most of them made so that someone else could move faster.
thesis.zh: 见缝插针造出来的东西：留给下一届的数学指北、黑客松里诞生的旅行故事工作室、在屏幕之间跳跃的光标、让 AI 智能体互相交接工作的桥——大多是为了让别人走得更快。

title.zh: London Cuts 旅行故事工作室

card.en: An AI-native travel-story and postcard studio in three visual modes — Fashion, Punk, Cinema — with a live public demo.
card.zh: AI 原生的旅行故事与明信片工作室，三种视觉模式——时装、朋克、电影——附在线公开演示。

title.zh: SocialOS：五天，1,222 次提交

card.en: A local-first relationship and identity OS, built by an orchestrated agent factory: 89% of the commits were made by agents.
card.zh: 一个本地优先的人际关系与身份操作系统，由编排好的智能体「工厂」建成：89% 的提交出自智能体。

title.zh: 天津大学数学学院本科生指北

card.en: A guide to studying maths at Tianjin University, written for the cohorts that came after — live at zhouyixiaoxiao.info.
card.zh: 一份在天大学数学的指南，写给后来的每一届——现在在 zhouyixiaoxiao.info。

title.zh: 为 Apple Silicon 重写的 CatchMouse

card.en: A clean Swift rewrite of a 2011 Intel-only utility: global hotkeys send the cursor to the left, centre or right display.
card.zh: 把一个 2011 年、只支持 Intel 的小工具用 Swift 彻底重写：全局快捷键把光标送到左、中、右任一块屏幕。

title.zh: 来路

dek.zh: 求学：天津 → 香港 → 布里斯托

card.en: Tianjin, Hong Kong, Chengdu, Geneva, Bristol: a maths degree with an oar in hand, and the 3+1 route to a Bristol MSc.
card.zh: 天津、香港、成都、日内瓦、布里斯托：一边划船一边读数学，以及去布里斯托读硕士的「3+1」。

why.en: The pieces were there before the PhD: random walks in the undergraduate thesis, maths turned computational in Hong Kong, and a habit of speaking up for other students.
why.zh: 读博之前，这些线索就都在了：本科论文里的随机游走，在香港变得可以计算的数学，以及替同学发声的习惯。

thesis.en: Tianjin, Hong Kong, Chengdu, Geneva, Bristol: a maths degree at Tianjin University (TJU) with an oar in hand, an exchange year at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) that turned the maths computational, a first internship, and the 3+1 route (three undergraduate years, the exchange year among them, then the fourth as a Bristol MSc) — the first shortcut, which skipped a year.
thesis.zh: 天津、香港、成都、日内瓦、布里斯托：在天津大学一边读数学一边划船的本科，在香港科技大学让数学变得可以计算的交换年，第一份实习，以及「3+1」（本科三年，含香港交换的一年；第四年读布里斯托硕士）——人生里的第一条捷径，径直跳过了一年。

title.en: Mathematics and Applied Mathematics, Tianjin University
title.zh: 天津大学数学与应用数学

card.en: 2021–2025 in the School of Mathematics, the final year at Bristol via the 3+1 route. Every walker on this site starts here.
card.zh: 2021 至 2025 年就读于数学学院，最后一年经「3+1」在布里斯托完成。本站每一个游走者，都从这里出发。

title.zh: 「3+1」：第一条捷径

card.en: Three years at Tianjin, then the one-year Bristol MSc: the bachelor's and the master's overlapped, and a year was skipped.
card.zh: 天大三年，再读布里斯托一年制硕士：本科与硕士叠在一起，一整年就这样被跳了过去。

title.en: An exchange year at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)
title.zh: 在香港科技大学交换一年

card.en: 2023–24 in Hong Kong: PDEs, their numerical solution and applied statistics — where the maths turned computational.
card.zh: 2023 至 2024 年在香港：偏微分方程、数值解法与应用统计——数学从此变得可以计算。

title.en: MSc Engineering Mathematics, University of Bristol
title.zh: 布里斯托大学工程数学硕士

card.en: To Bristol in September 2024: statistical computing, information theory, mathematical biology, methods of AI.
card.zh: 2024 年 9 月来到布里斯托：统计计算、信息论、生物数学建模、人工智能方法。

title.zh: 此刻

card.en: Edinburgh poster on 25 November, a paper submitted to Physical Review E, another in preparation, a desktop agent in development.
card.zh: 11 月 25 日爱丁堡海报、一篇已投稿《物理评论 E》、一篇在写、一个开发中的桌面智能体。

why.en: A snapshot with a date on it, so the record stays honest: what is finished lives in the chapters; what is still moving is here.
why.zh: 这是一张带日期的快照，好让记录保持诚实：做完的在各章里，还在走的在这里。

thesis.en: As at the build date: a poster to present in Edinburgh, a paper submitted to Physical Review E (a physics journal) and another in preparation, a desktop agent in development, a new teaching year and a second year as PhD student rep. The walkers still in flight.
thesis.zh: 截至建站当日：一张要带去爱丁堡的海报，一篇已投稿《物理评论 E》、一篇仍在打磨的论文，一个开发中的桌面智能体，新学年的课，以及第二年的博士生代表。这些，是仍在飞行中的游走者。

card.zh: 2026 年 11 月 24 日至 25 日，约翰·麦金泰尔会议中心。并排演示：从日常提示一键切到同音陷阱。

title.zh: 几何控制的折叠——已投稿《物理评论 E》

status.en: Submitted to Physical Review E · Jul 2026

card.en: Single-author regular article, the capstone of the double-peak line. Submitted to Physical Review E (a physics journal), 30 Jul 2026.
card.zh: 单作者常规论文，双峰研究线的收官之作。2026 年 7 月 30 日投稿《物理评论 E》（Physical Review E），审稿中。

line.en: The same habit — measure the hidden route — aimed first at random walkers, then at AI agents.
line.zh: 同一个习惯——测量隐藏的路径——先对准随机游走者，再对准 AI 智能体。
